intro_title: Where the Big Five still roam
intro_paras: India is extraordinarily rich in wildlife — 103 national parks, 537 sanctuaries, and a density of life few places on earth can match. For over three decades we've been among the first to open its wildest belt, Northeast India, to travellers from around the world.
The Asiatic lion, leopard, Royal Bengal tiger, Asiatic elephant and one-horned rhino — India's Big Five — and four of them can be found in the lush green state of Assam alone.
